label: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice sandboxes
description: How Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: Mod Engine is not a mod and is not installed here; install it into the game folder and point its modengine.ini at the mods folder.
Never connect to the online services with a modified install.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.
